answer: Counterparty diversity stops a sybil orchard. A newcomer must trade with 15 unrelated partners in 20 epochs for rewards; verifiers audit its graph. Deals that ripple only in one closed circle earn nothing, and a nebula of clones trading with itself is flagged as one cluster. Each identity posts 50 tokens, slashed if fake. Forging 1,000 identities locks 50,000 tokens for no payout; one honest agent pays 50 tokens and keeps its reward undiluted.
